summary: Production Hardening pass verified. Full backend pytest suite (tests/) run twice: run1 = 826 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed (437s). run2 initially showed 2 failures in test_plans_admin_fork.py, but RCA confirmed this was caused by MY OWN manual curl testing (calling taper-apply on greenlantern for the taper-apply idempotency check) polluting greenlantern's snapshot before run2 started -- not a real regression. Restored greenlantern's week-1 snapshot to pristine and re-ran test_plans_admin_fork.py alone: 10/10 passed. All 3 named P0 bug fixes verified working end-to-end via live API calls against the preview backend: (1) Coach chat plan-edit correctly mutates ONLY the calling rider's own plan snapshot (rider A ctr-ride-1 -> 33 min, fresh rider B on same plan stayed at 20 min), (2) taper-apply idempotency confirmed (call 1: applied:true, call 2: applied:true+already:true, no 500s), (3) sandbox activity import isolation confirmed (two fresh riders each imported:4, each GET /connections/activities returned exactly 4, no cross-user collision). New isolation test file test_p0_cross_user_isolation_expansion.py: 12/12 passed. Scenic POI endpoint (dutch-countryside, refresh=true) returned 6 POIs (>=3 guard working). Email digest endpoint returned ok:true with backend logs confirming EMAIL_SANDBOX_MODE simulated sends (no real Resend network calls, no failures from the expired key). Frontend smoke test: login (email/password), home screen, and Training Plan screen all render correctly with no red-screen errors and no new console errors -- consistent with a backend-only session.

minor.issue: test_plans_admin_fork.py::TestEditIsolation/TestAdapt assume greenlantern's ctr-ride-1 baseline is exactly '20 min'. Any prior manual/exploratory taper-apply call against the shared preview greenlantern account (outside the test's own restore logic in test_iter81_..._taper_apply_streak.py) will break this baseline assumption on the next run. Not a product bug, but a shared-state test fragility worth hardening (e.g. self-heal the baseline via the same _restore_rider_week helper, or scope this test to its own fresh rider instead of the shared greenlantern account).
File is 968 lines, exceeds the 700-line guideline for file size; consider splitting admin vs rider-facing route groups into separate modules in a future cleanup (not urgent, no functional issue).

issues: 'Your Training Plan' heading renders as a single-character-per-line vertical stack in the narrow left column layout on the 390px mobile viewport -- likely a flex/width constraint issue on the heading Text, pre-existing and unrelated to this backend-only session; worth a follow-up UI pass.

rca_of_issue: test_plans_admin_fork.py::TestEditIsolation/TestAdapt failed on run2 because I (the testing agent) manually called POST /api/coach/taper-apply against greenlantern@roujaune.app during my own API verification of the taper-apply idempotency requirement, which eased greenlantern's OWN couch-to-road week-1 ctr-ride-1 duration from '20 min' to '18 min' via the (correctly-fixed) _apply_companion_ops rider-scoping. test_plans_admin_fork.py's baseline assertion hardcodes '20 min' for greenlantern and has no self-restore for that specific mutation path (only test_iter81_...taper_apply_streak.py restores the week IT eases, via _restore_rider_week). I manually restored greenlantern's week-1 snapshot back to pristine from couch_to_road_plan.json and re-ran test_plans_admin_fork.py in isolation: 10/10 passed, confirming the underlying isolation logic (admin template edits never reach an already-snapshotted rider) is correct and this was purely test-order/shared-state pollution from my verification steps, not an application regression.
